summary: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY): — Flagship scheme comprehensively covered in the Government Schemes Consolidated Masterfile.

blocks.title: 🏛️ Canonical Reference & Masterfile Integration
blocks.text: This flagship scheme is comprehensively detailed in the Government Schemes Masterfile (Section: "migrated-schemes-masterfile"). Key highlights and parameters are summarized below.

items: Premium: Rs. 20 annually, auto-debited from bank
Rs. 2 lakh for accidental death/total disability
Eligibility: Ages 18-70, with linked Aadhaar and bank account
Objective: Affordable accident insurance for financial security
Enrollment & Administration: Through public sector banks and insurance companies
Impact: Enhances financial inclusion, particularly for low-income groups.
